summary.allegation: The issuer says the cardholder did not authorise the EUR 1,240.50 transaction of 1 April 2025 with Velo Continental Rentals and suggests the card details were compromised.
summary.to_defend: Mastercard 4837 requires any two of: full AVS plus CVV match, successful 3D Secure authentication, two prior undisputed transactions with matching billing details, or signed proof of delivery to the billing address.

requirements.finding: The gateway authorisation log for txn_4412EF records a full-address AVS match (Y) and a CVV match (M), consistent with the transaction metadata.

requirements.title: Two prior undisputed transactions
requirements.text: Two prior undisputed transactions from the same cardholder with this merchant in the past 12 months, with matching billing details.
requirements.finding: No transaction history was supplied; the only hint of prior activity is the gateway note that the device fingerprint is a 'Returning device (seen 3x)', which does not identify prior undisputed transactions or their billing details.
requirements.gap: No list of two prior undisputed transactions by this cardholder in the last 12 months with matching billing details.

requirements.title: Signed delivery to billing address
requirements.text: Proof of delivery to the cardholder's billing address with signature.
requirements.finding: MCC 7512 (vehicle rental) with no goods shipment in evidence; this is a rental service, so signed proof of delivery to the billing address cannot apply.

reasons: Every requirement the decision relies on is backed by verified evidence

justification: Two of the four compelling-evidence requirements (R1 full AVS+CVV match and R2 successful Identity Check authentication) are clearly satisfied, meeting the code's any-two threshold.
rationale: The issuer alleges the cardholder did not authorise the EUR 1,240.50 transaction txn_4412EF of 1 April 2025 with Velo Continental Rentals. The gateway authorisation log for that transaction ID records a full-address AVS match (Y) and a CVV match (M), matching the authorisation metadata. The Mastercard Identity Check record ic_77f31a82bb for the same transaction shows a frictionless AUTHENTICATED outcome with ECI 02, authentication value present and DS transaction ID ds_4b2e1100c4, timestamped 2025-04-01 11:08:18 UTC by the issuer BNP Paribas, placing fraud liability with the issuer. The order was placed from a French IP (90.84.21.117, Paris) on a device fingerprint previously seen with this merchant, and the billing and shipping postcodes both match 75011. Two of the four compelling-evidence requirements are satisfied, so the chargeback is represented in full.
